administration.persistence: Existing authored content + immutable CMS revisions in PostgreSQL

verification.publicAndEditorRegressionSuites: 71 tests passed across StudioGallery, StudioGalleryManagement, studioGallery parser, CmsAdminPage and TdfPlatformPage.

rollout: Apply the registered backend migration before deploying the UI. Protected PR approval, checks and production release remain required. Existing preview-origin API CORS limitations are unchanged.
